name: Smoldering Crust
look: a primeval red Groudon crawling on four limbs, ridged with grey bone spikes and traced with dark blue lines, with black claws and jagged yellow heat plumes pouring from its back
entry: A Pokémon resembling Groudon, described in an old explorer's journal about a crawling beast that left scorched furrows across the land. Heat pours from its back in shimmering waves.
how: Wild: very rare by day in badlands and deserts when it isn't raining.
